rationale: Both candidates go well beyond the thin ground truth (whose two substantive concerns were already fixed in-diff, per the 'Done' reply), independently re-discovering residual bugs in the same lookup_model_spec area and both flagging the duration/audio-truncation gap and the dead 'type' comment. X has broader coverage (VALIDATE_INPUTS unreachability, image→frame back-compat break) but two findings are overstated or mis-cited (the 'image_2 always raises' claim is false in the single-slot case, and the kwargs/line citation for the compat-break claim appears to reference the wrong method). Y's findings are uniformly backed by precise line/quote citations cross-checked against server code, recipes, and CI config, yielding fewer unverifiable or incorrect claims, though it misses the VALIDATE_INPUTS and input-rename issues entirely. Actionability is comparably strong for both.
